Войдите в Radient, чтобы загрузить команду на этот компьютер; intro 'При загрузке команда копируется…'
'Добавьте агента coder дважды в release-crew' fixed; the sibling examples.team_shipping still has the bare token — recorded here as ru-r2-agc-02
«{name}» в хабе как набор инструкций. Прочитать и установить его может любой.

Я принимаю — the round-1 record itself says 'no fix required unless legal wants the read-limb'; the ru consent formula stays gender-neutral and the linked 'условия использования' carries the object.

not_defects.why: 'этого агента' is genitive, not the capitalised nominative the English stand-in uses: every Russian pull template puts the subject after 'загрузить' or 'не найти', so the genitive is the correct form and no sentence is broken. Verified by rendering all twelve pull sentences with both subject variants.
Copula-less present ('«X» в хабе как набор инструкций') is grammatical Russian for a status line and is the exact wording round 1 proposed; no meaning is lost.
'в хабе {org}' composes correctly with both count phrases and with the 'этой организации' placeholder ('5 агентов в хабе этой организации'), and matches the shipped lowercase 'хаб' for a location.
Mid-sentence 'Хаб агентов' is the established product-surface spelling in the shipped ru catalogue (ui.agents.dialogs.create.hub_link), not a Title Case slip.

EN 'from this machine' names the failing side; a literal 'загрузить команду с этого компьютера' would read as an upload direction in Russian, so the destination phrasing states the same user-visible outcome. Considered and cleared.
The colon is copy (sidecar: the date arrives preformatted); joined with ' · ' it renders 'Создано: 10 окт. 2026 г. · Обновлено: …', which is idiomatic.
'Повторная попытка…' is accurate: the sidecar says it replaces 'Try again' while the refetch runs, so every rendering is a retry.

findings.category: accuracy / omission in an accessible name
findings.problem: The org roster section has no visible heading (org-teams-list.tsx:240-247), so this aria-label is the region's only name, and the source names the sharing relation. 'Команды {org}' reads as ownership ('Acme's teams'), while the list holds teams shared INTO the org; the same namespace's org.empty/org.unreadable say 'открытые для …'.

The summary sentence is record-neutral in English: summary.created/updated take an agent OR team {name} (sidecar: '{name} is the agent or team name'), and RunSummary appends this clause to either. 'откройте агента' hard-codes the agent, so a team result reads 'Обновлено release-crew (team): изменены свойства. … откройте агента'. diffCatalogue emits empty-change updates for teams too, so the state is reachable and names the wrong record type.
